claims.claim: Heavy duty 2.5 Ton manual hydraulic pallet jack
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows two wooden pallet jacks but no brand, model, or capacity plate; load capacity rating and pump function are listed as not shown.

risks.risk: Hydraulic pump does not function or leaks
risks.proof: Short video of pumping the handle to lift a load, plus close-up of the pump for leaks

risks.risk: Wheels do not roll smoothly or are damaged
risks.proof: Video of each jack being rolled across a flat tiled floor

risks.risk: Hidden cracks or damage to wood slats, forks, or metal plates
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the fork ends, wood slats, triangular plates, and handle base

risks.risk: Actual load capacity is below 2.5 Ton or unknown
risks.proof: Photo of any capacity rating plate or stamping on the jack

risks.risk: Age and extent of prior use are unknown
risks.proof: Close-up photos showing wear on forks, handle, and wheels

proof_requests: Video of the hydraulic pump lifting a load
Close-up photo of any capacity plate or stamping
Video of the jacks being rolled on a flat floor
Close-up photos of forks, wood slats, metal plates, and handle base for cracks
response.reason: The witness identifies the items as wooden pallet jacks, so a worst-case price is possible even though capacity, pump function, and condition are unproven.
